checks.title: product human approval and source traceability
Idea/document intake sources, revisions and permissions are explicit
evidence: Original idea and decisions retained or official BA source URL/version recorded
External research has cited provenance or is marked unavailable
No unauthorized Confluence publishing or source overwrites

checks.title: SRS and use cases maintain stable requirement IDs and explicit review
evidence: FR/NFR/US/AC/UC trace to canonical approved requirements
Unconfirmed constraints and review gates remain pending
OpenSpec handoff references approved scope only

checks.title: MVP completeness and product outcome authority
evidence: Usable end-to-end journey, explicit in/out scope and requirement/AC links
Metrics/targets and scope approval source or unresolved owner

checks.title: Review proportional verification and selective docs
evidence: Applicable project methods and actual host limitations
Requirement-linked raw evidence, business assertions and owned cleanup
Static UNVERIFIED claims and affected-section source policy
Incremental sections, related-flow outcomes and checkpoint links; stale groups rerun before retaining PASS

checks.title: Continuous change review
evidence: Stable rule/AC IDs and source-linked section changes
Feedback deduplicated and proposed until accepted; no automatic scope expansion
